In certain circles the term '''la su'o da''' (''"Someone"'') has become a well-known phrase.

{{irci|akmnlrse|There's this meme going around here that all the work in Lojbandia is done by some sort of god named ''Someone'' since people keep on saying "someone should do this".}}

Indeed, '''la su'o da''' most often appears in sentences beginning with '''.ei''', like this one:

{{mu|.ei la su'o da ba cikre|"Someone should fix this."}}

or really anytime someone wishes to exclude themselves from a pool of potentially responsible people; '''la su'o da''' carries an undertone of ''"someone (but not me!) should do this, and I'm just going to wait until it happens"'' (aka let someone else do the work).
